_doc: Config for the global-proxy-scan scheduled task (2x/week, Tue + Fri). Restructured 2026-08-31 (v2) into THEMES, each with its bellwether global concalls + the Indian listed proxy(ies) it points to + a lifecycle status. The task runs 4 stages: (A) global signal scan - rotating reads of the bellwether universe + open-tape search for NEW themes; (B) Indian-proxy mapping for new / re-accelerating themes only; (C) India-signal verification - for a proxy already researched under an accelerating tailwind (await_india_check=true), check the Indian company's OWN latest order book / capacity / guidance / pricing for the SAME signal the bellwether showed; (D) portfolio hand-off - write the alignment verdict to valuepickr-screen/global-signal-alignment.md, which portfolio-rs1l-revision consumes. Method + rationale: playbook/ishmohit-soic-style.md section 6. Edit this file to add/retire themes or bellwethers without touching the task prompt. New themes found by Stage A's discovery search are appended here by the task itself.

_status_enum.active: tailwind live; read on cadence, seed/verify proxies normally
_status_enum.dormant: read decelerating 2 runs running (decel_streak >= decelerating_runs_to_dormant), OR manually parked; no proxy seeding, active_themes.json priority -> 3, re-read only monthly (coverage_cadence_days bumped to 30). Auto-reactivates if a monthly read comes back accelerating.
_status_enum.harvested: proxy already researched at Medium-High+ AND held in docs/FINAL_PORTFOLIO_RECOMMENDATION.md AND tailwind only steady (not accelerating); the trade is on, nothing to add. Monthly read only. Reverts to active if tailwind re-accelerates.

_proxy_action_state_enum.hypothesis: candidate proxy name(s) named here but not yet pushed to state.json
_proxy_action_state_enum.seeded: written into valuepickr-screen/state.json as status=candidate, source=global-proxy for vpscreen-scan to research
_proxy_action_state_enum.researched: vpscreen-scan has researched it; if theme tailwind is accelerating/steady-tight, await_india_check is set true so Stage C picks it up
_proxy_action_state_enum.signal_confirmed: Stage C found the same signal in the Indian company's own numbers (order book / capacity / guidance / pricing)
_proxy_action_state_enum.signal_partial: Stage C found some but not full alignment
_proxy_action_state_enum.signal_not_yet: global tailwind real but not yet visible in the Indian name - keep re-checking on stage_c_recheck_days
_proxy_action_state_enum.signal_diverging: Indian company's own numbers contradict the global tailwind - a caution / trim signal
